turns.text: Bluewater Insurance Partners · Escalation · October 16, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** Gwen Albright (COO), [PERSON_1] (Director, Agency Operations), [PERSON_2] (CRM & Telephony Administrator), [PERSON_3] (Invoca CSM), [PERSON_4] (Invoca Support Escalations Lead)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Gwen raised concerns about PreSense transfer reliability and the stalled [PERSON_5], linking both to the contract. [PERSON_3] and [PERSON_4] asked questions on the PreSense data gap and QM seat [PERSON_6]. Next steps assigned.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: PreSense transfer issue
turns.text: [PERSON_2] said it occurs after a Genesys blind transfer. [PERSON_3] and [PERSON_4] asked for examples and timelines; [PERSON_4] will investigate with engineering.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: live at 4 of 11 agencies. [PERSON_1] cited agent mix (about half part-time) as a factor; Gwen tied expansion to PreSense reliability.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_6]
turns.text: [PERSON_1] questioned per-seat QM [PERSON_6] given part-time agents. [PERSON_3] will follow up with [PERSON_6] team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_7]
turns.text: tracking, Signal AI, Genesys, Salesforce, Google Ads all fine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_8]
turns.text: renewal 2027-07-31; next check-in in two weeks.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] confirmed PreSense data is missing on roughly one in five calls after a Genesys blind transfer.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Gwen said plainly that if transfers aren't reliable by Q1 she will not expand QM to the remaining agencies and will revisit the contract.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] pushed back on QM being priced per seat when half their agents are part-time.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Gwen may pause QM expansion and revisit contract if PreSense transfer issues aren't resolved by Q1.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_4] to gather call examples and open engineering investigation by Oct 20.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to review QM [PERSON_6] options with [PERSON_6] team by Oct 23.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Gwen to share additional PreSense failure examples by Oct 19.

turns.speaker: Notes
